Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/583ac67d72d1bf9d513b0a2250b9ffabe348529774677a754fd45ccfa0735260.png]
questions.solution:
As 1 and 2 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 3 and 4 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d9dba2f56aeabb5e54a120c8d0e00f8baee687127836bec605ec4072ad3c228.png] 

As 1 and 4 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 2 and 5 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/882f07a6fd0b98c9ac3005c5194c6623d60d70895e7dfb6bcc6f0634d514cd60.png] 

Now, remaining faces 1 and 6 must be opposite to each other.

Therefore, '1' is the number on the face opposite the face showing '6'.

Hence, ‘**1**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

18, 20, ?, 128, 514, 2572

Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

12 : 3 :: 28 : 7 :: 32 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First number ÷ 4 = Second number

 
• 12 : 3 → 12 ÷ 4 = 3
 
• 28 : 7 → 28 ÷ 4 = 7 

Similarly,

 
• 32 : ? → 32 ÷ 4 = 8

Hence, '**8**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Amir, Bunty, Leslie, Pradeep, Eshan, Faiz, Gaurav and Harish are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Pradeep sits third to the right of Gaurav. Pradeep sits at one of the corners. Bunty sits second to the right of Faiz. Faiz does not sit at any of the corners. Bunty is not an immediate neighbour of Pradeep. Harish is an immediate neighbour of Amir. Harish does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. Only one person sits between Harish and Leslie.

Who sits third to the right of Amir?
questions.solution:
**Amir, Bunty, Leslie, Pradeep, Eshan, Faiz, Gaurav and Harish** are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

1. Pradeep sits third to the right of Gaurav.

2. Pradeep sits at one of the corners.

3. Bunty is not an immediate neighbour of Pradeep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/111435d8ea3257683c2998f60aee7faa5d61f31d76b67a81e725f8a1c925e6d9.png] 

4. Faiz does not sit at any of the corners. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fcd469856405609cb9169673ebd27029f52baaae691c5e7e26219283adf5577.png] 

5. Bunty sits second to the right of Faiz.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c86e6811e6f8dcbfd752a58533b95b2be5348fb3746e1de76ab15b73ef687919.png] 

6. Harish is an immediate neighbour of Amir.

7. Harish does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7908cf519ffffb38dba88cdb2f11d50ed308f8667f9e02bb1df88ed43d144049.png] 

8. Only one person sits between Harish and Leslie.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e64f1a78d065131da30ef6889cbc09812a719fd0b6d24b9c38dec62f58c130d8.png] 

Eshan the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e369b43c843b3e60af58b5b162eff5ed540c154f5053cdfa67294db8f5b8c27.png] 

Clearly, Eshan sits third to the right of Amir.

Hence, ‘**Eshan**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option which is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words are to be treated as meaningful words and not related to each other on the basis of the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word.)

Jewish : Torah :: Christian : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **Second word is the religious text of the first word.

 
• Jewish : Torah → Torah is the religious text of Jews

Similarly,

 
• Christian → Bible is the religious text of Christians.

Hence, '**Bible**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:

Ore : Metal :: Milk : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Second one is extracted from the first one.

 
• Ore : Metal → Ore is a naturally occurring solid material from which a metal or valuable mineral can be profitably extracted.

Similarly,

 
• Milk : ? → Curd is a soft, white substance formed when milk sours.

Hence, '**Curd**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

All camels are fractals.

No fractal is a tube.

All pianos are camels.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tubes are camels.

II. No piano is a tube.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd54e59cc9abd6d7e48b146fd3a0dd252197e0780eab0630ca2c30b6e961fa8f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tubes are camels. → Does not follow (As, All camels are fractals and No fractal is a tube, which means no camel is tube)

II. No piano is a tube. → **Follows** (As, All pianos are camel, All camels are fractals and No fractal is a tube, which means no piano is a tube)

Hence, '**Only conclusion II follows**' is the correct answer.
